stage: Immediately after project restoration (lifecycleState: ACTIVE), before any billing action -- first attempt to read the original object

response.message: The billing account for the owning project is disabled in state absent.

note: This is the key operational finding: project.lifecycleState returned to ACTIVE, but the Cloud Billing association was not automatically restored by projects.undelete. Cloud Storage object-level reads fail closed without an enabled billing account, distinct from any retention-related error. Cross-referenced by ../billing-disabled-after-restore.json (billingEnabled: false at this same point in time). The original gcloud diagnostic text included the authenticated account's email in a client-identity sentence ('This command is authenticated as ...'); that sentence has been removed here as unnecessary account identity information -- the substantive error (billing account disabled) is preserved verbatim.
